decisions.reason: Assigning the Politics category to the Adrian Navarro article does not change the required author identity, photo source, or placement after the category label.
The article category mapping does not change the required size or circular shape of author photos.
The Adrian Navarro article category assignment does not affect the separate color restriction for the Dorian Vale article.
Identifying the Adrian Navarro article as Politics does not alter the requirement to source article content from the website.
The category mapping adds article metadata but does not change the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The article category assignment does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The category mapping has no effect on the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The article category assignment neither changes the deferred print-ready output specifications nor resumes that deliverable.
